2025.Title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
2025.Author: Brandon Sanderson
2025.ShortReview: Absolutely loved it. Got me back into reading. Kelsier... Sazed... Marsh... Vin... every character is SO COOL!
2025.Review: This is the book that got me back into reading. It certainly felt cliche at times, but the lore, characters, and world building just had me wanting more each time I finished a chapter. The main characters are a fantastic duo, and you just know there's so much more for them to learn about their powers as the series progresses.

2025.Title: Dune
2025.Author: Frank Herbert
2025.ShortReview: Good, but not interested in reading the rest of the series... 🪱
2025.Review: I found this book interesting and incredibly unique compared to anything I have read before. I was quite immersed with the descriptions of Paul and his mother navigating Arrakis. However, I felt it moved at an odd pace. The middle half of the book was slow, but rich of story. Then the ending of the book felt too fast in comparison, as if it was skipping over too much detail. I do not feel inclined to read the rest of the books in the series, but I did enjoy my time reading this book.

2026.Title: Mistborn: The Well of Ascension
2026.Author: Brandon Sanderson
2026.ShortReview: Good, like the first, but it was very much 'set up for the third book'. I think some of the story was a bit too cliche/predictable, and I could skim-read a lot without missing anything.

2026.Title: Mistborn: The Hero of Ages
2026.Author: Brandon Sanderson
2026.ShortReview: What a book this was. I felt like every chapter, every decision Brandon made with this book was perfectly crafted to amaze the reader. You MUST read this if you're interested in Fantasy! If the first book got me back into reading, then this book will keep me reading for the rest of my life.

2026.Title: The C# Player's Guide (Fifth Edition)
2026.Author: RB Whitaker
2026.ShortReview: I originally read this in the summer of 2022/2023 and loved it! I bought it again in 2026 to have the updated PDF version along with its latest book expansions (C# 13 Expansion released 20 Jan 2025). I have some of the 'boss battles' from the book on my GitHub, if you're interested.
